title: Navimower Map Card 0.3.2-beta1

### Added
- Automatic mower artwork selection from the Home Assistant mower model, with H1/H2, i-series, i2 LiDAR, X3, and X4 artwork.
- Manual **Mower icon** override in the visual editor and YAML.
- **History days** setting from 1 to 31, defaulting to 3 days.

### Changed
- History always offers the configured calendar-day range, including days without mowing sessions.
- The selected day shows all of its sessions; the old **Maximum sessions shown** control no longer limits History.
- **Show session times** only controls the session-time row.
- All mower artwork remains embedded in the existing single HACS runtime file; this prerelease adds no extra runtime assets.
